column1: # EXP-R2-233: one unconditional author-native ProGen3-3B generation point.
# Freeze this queue with the runner before dispatch; GPU 0 is root-assigned.
# Native prompt 1, N-to-C, 800 raw attempts, batch 8, seed 20260905 plus batch
# index, bfloat16, temperature 0.85, top-p 0.95, top-k 50, repetition penalty 1.
# Native API min/max-new-tokens 0/400 adds two terminal-token allowances, so the
# effective HF maximum is 402. These settings are fixed in progen3_generation.py
# and cannot be overridden by CLI. No label/prefix, reranking, or output filter.
# The 3B-specific strict-load, cached-logit, and native-interface gates execute
# before scientific attempts. Keep raw output, compiler failures and censoring.
# Final completion is generation_summary.json, written only after all 800
# attempts and the 128-original-plus-128-shuffle structure sample are persisted.
# --out and --device are supplied once by the queue, not duplicated in args.
